Exercise personal judgement to solve difficult problems where appropriate and provide guidance to junior team members.</li><li>Support the development of new opportunities and proposals by working with clients to understand their needs, define project scopes, and provide technical support on bids.</li><li>Work closely with a multi-disciplinary team in the UK and overseas to deliver integrated design solutions.</li><li>Adhere to quality assurance standards in design including check and review of your own work as well as others.</li></ul><p></p><h2>About you</h2><p></p><ul><li>A degree in Chemical / Process Engineering or equivalent.</li><li>Chartered or Incorporated Chemical / Process Engineer.</li><li>Proven experience in coordinating or managing a Clean Water Process engineering team for a design consultancy including within a multi-disciplinary environment.</li><li>Takes a broad perspective to identify innovative solutions to design problems.</li><li>Requires strong knowledge and design / practical experience in drinking water treatment process and principles – conventional and advanced treatment technologies.</li><li>Practical knowledge of current design codes and standards as well as industry best practices, including CDM Regulations.</li><li>Ability to work independently with minimal technical guidance.</li><li>Experience in design and delivery of projects with adherence to UK safety and environmental regulations, process safety techniques (e.g. HAZOP), knowledge of capital and operational costs - and risk assessments.</li><li>Experience in the UK Water market is preferred.</li><li>Demonstrates strong communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly and effectively within diverse multi-disciplinary teams.</li><li>A proactive, highly motivated mindset with a collaborative approach to drive teamwork and share success across projects.</li><li>Meet some but not all the criteria?
